lines.text: Many learners say: Do you can swim?

native.tip: “Can” ya forma la pregunta solo: “Can you swim?”, sin “do”.
native.caption: ¿Mezclas “do” y “can”? 🏊 No digas “Do you can swim?”, sino “Can you swim?”. ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “drive”. Tras “can”, el verbo va sin “s”. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.hook: “Do you can”? You do not need “do”
en.tip: “Can” makes the question by itself: “Can you swim?”, without “do”.
en.caption: Mixing “do” and “can”? Do not say “Do you can swim?”, say “Can you swim?”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
